To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quality of Corporate governance is positively related to the quality of the internal controls over financial reporting.
the Audit Quality, measured by the number of Deficiencies in the internal controls, is directly correlated to Corporate Governance quality.

1) there is a significant relation between Audit Quality and Corporate Governance quality; 2) the relation is positive; 3) there is a relation also with the number of Entity, Process, IT Controls; 4) the relation is stronger when the number of Controls is greater.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between Corporate Governance and Audit Quality and the results are in line with the literature.

the relationship between Audit Quality, as measured by the Deficiencies of Internal Controls, and Corporate Governance, measured by selected characteristics of Board of Directors, Audit Committee and Internal Audit.
the relation between the quality of Corporate Audit and Corporate Governance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of Audit is directly influenced by the quality of Corporate Governace.
Audit Quality and Corporate Governance Quality are related.

Corporate Governance is positively correlated to the quality of the Audit, and that Audit Quality is positively correlated to Control Quality, which is in turn positively correlated to Corporate Governance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Corporate Governance and Audit Quality are interdependent.
Audit Quality and Corporate Governance are correlated and that Audit Quality is a function of Corporate Governance quality.

Corporate Governance quality is positively related to Audit Quality, which in turn, is positively related to the effectiveness of internal control systems, as a consequence of their design and implementation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Audit Quality can be improved by enhancing Corporate Governance, and that this is a valid and useful tool to improve the quality of financial reporting and the reliability of the financial statements, and thus to reduce the risk of fraud and the probability of litigation.
the quality of Audit Quality and Corporate Governance is not a simple matter of the number of controls, but rather depends on their design and effectiveness, and on their life-cycle.
the quality of Corporate governance is a key factor in the effectiveness of Internal Control Systems.
